description.p: Locus is a system monitor for Wayland desktops, built with GTK 4 and libadwaita. It graphs the whole machine, and lists the running processes with what each takes of the processor, the memory and the disks.

ul.li: Processor usage as a whole and for each core, memory and swap, network and disk traffic
Room left on each mounted disk
Processes sorted by processor, memory or disk use, searchable by name, command line or ID
End, kill, stop and continue a process, from its menu or the bar beneath the list

description.p: Everything is read from /proc and /sys, and processes are read only while their list is on screen.

screenshot.caption: The processor, memory, network and disks of the machine

description.p: The first release: processes with their processor, memory and disk use, which can be ended, killed, stopped and continued; graphs of the processor, each of its cores, memory and swap, the network and the disks; and the room left on each mounted disk.
